description: Abdullah Shah Ghazi Sugar Mills Limited is a Pakistani sugar producer, incorporated on 25 February 1984 as a private limited company under the name Al-Asif Sugar Mills Limited and converted to a public limited company on 11 February 1990. Its mill at Gharo in district Thatta, Sindh has an installed capacity of 3,000 tons of cane per day and produces refined white sugar. The Macca Group acquired the company in March 2008 and now holds over 90 per cent of it; for years the mill operated under a toll manufacturing agreement with Dewan Sugar Mills Limited, which the Macca Group management terminated so that the company now works independently.
